top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 117 RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 23 were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 117 FEC RFAI letters and Form 99 filings received since October 23, 2026. All 117 were already reported in a prior edition, so none are new today. No red-flag keyword hits turned up.

The query for voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more timed out at the FEC (HTTP 504), so that check did not complete in this run. The absence of voided-transaction rows below reflects the failed query, not a confirmed empty result.

sections.headline: $725,515 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 3 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $725,515 in all. Largest target: Angie Craig (support, $403,515). 1 spender(s) registered in the last 180 days.

items: No Going Back PAC Inc.: $135,000 — registered 9/1/2026, a new committee

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/23/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 23, 2026 onward, as of the Monday, October 26, 2026 PM edition.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The FEC Schedule A query for voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more timed out (HTTP 504, 'Query timed out'), so voided and negative transactions were not checked in this edition.

apod.title: M42: The Great Nebula in Orion
apod.caption: The Great Nebula in Orion, an immense, nearby starbirth region, is one of the most famous of all astronomical nebulas. Here, glowing gas surrounds hot young stars at the edge of an immense interstellar molecular cloud only 1500 light-years away.
